article_context: 文章为高管高薪提供经济学解释：顶级企业机会扩张而顶级CEO人才稀缺，岗位所需能力也更复杂；治理更严格却薪酬仍上升，作者据此认为高薪并不能简单归因于内部掠夺。

article.title: 阅读 Text 2 · 为什么顶级 CEO 薪酬持续上涨
article.background: 文章为高管高薪提供经济学解释：顶级企业机会扩张而顶级CEO人才稀缺，岗位所需能力也更复杂；治理更严格却薪酬仍上升，作者据此认为高薪并不能简单归因于内部掠夺。

sentences.en: It is true that CEO pay has gone up—top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%.
sentences.zh: CEO薪酬确实上涨了：顶尖CEO的平均收入可能达到普通员工的300倍；不同估算显示，自20世纪70年代中期以来，美国大型上市公司CEO的薪酬大约上涨了500%。

segments.text: It is true that CEO pay has gone up—top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%.

sentences.en: The typical CEO of a top American corporation now makes about $18.9 million a year.
sentences.zh: 如今，美国顶级公司的典型CEO年收入约为1890万美元。

segments.text: The typical CEO of a top American corporation now makes about $18.9 million a year.

sentences.en: The best model for understanding the growth of CEO pay is that of limited CEO talent in a world where business opportunities for the top firms are growing rapidly.
sentences.zh: 理解CEO薪酬增长的最好模型，是在顶级企业商业机会迅速扩张的世界里，真正优秀的CEO人才却十分有限。

segments.text: The best model for understanding the growth of CEO pay is that of limited CEO talent in a world where business opportunities for the top firms are growing rapidly.

sentences.en: The efforts of America's highest-earning 1% have been one of the more dynamic elements of the global economy.
sentences.zh: 美国收入最高的1%人群所作的努力，一直是全球经济中更具活力的因素之一。

segments.text: The efforts of America's highest-earning 1% have been one of the more dynamic elements of the global economy.

sentences.en: It's not popular to say, but one reason their pay has gone up so much is that CEOs really have upped their game relative to many other workers in the U.S. economy.
sentences.zh: 这种说法可能不讨喜，但CEO薪酬大幅上涨的一个原因，是与美国经济中的许多其他劳动者相比，他们确实提升了自身能力。

segments.text: It's not popular to say, but one reason their pay has gone up so much is that CEOs really have upped their game relative to many other workers in the U.S. economy.

sentences.en: Today's CEO, at least for major American firms, must have many more skills than simply being able to “run the company.”
sentences.zh: 如今的CEO，至少在美国大型企业中，所需技能远不只是“把公司经营起来”。

segments.text: Today's CEO, at least for major American firms, must have many more skills than simply being able to “run the company.”

sentences.en: CEOs must have a good sense of financial markets and maybe even how the company should trade in them.
sentences.zh: CEO必须对金融市场有良好判断，甚至还要懂得公司应当如何参与其中的交易。

segments.text: CEOs must have a good sense of financial markets and maybe even how the company should trade in them.

sentences.en: They also need better public relations skills than their predecessors, as the costs of even a minor slipup can be significant.
sentences.zh: 他们还需要比前任更强的公共关系能力，因为哪怕一个小小失误，代价也可能很大。

segments.text: They also need better public relations skills than their predecessors, as the costs of even a minor slipup can be significant.

sentences.en: Then there's the fact that large American companies are much more globalized than ever before, with supply chains spread across a larger number of countries.
sentences.zh: 此外，美国大型企业如今比以往任何时候都更加全球化，供应链分布在更多国家。

segments.text: Then there's the fact that large American companies are much more globalized than ever before, with supply chains spread across a larger number of countries.

sentences.en: To lead in that system requires knowledge that is fairly mind-boggling.
sentences.zh: 要领导这样一个体系，需要掌握的知识之多几乎令人难以想象。

segments.text: To lead in that system requires knowledge that is fairly mind-boggling.

sentences.en: Plus, virtually all major American companies are becoming tech companies, often with their own research and development.
sentences.zh: 而且，几乎所有美国大型企业都在变成科技企业，往往还拥有自己的研发体系。

segments.text: Plus, virtually all major American companies are becoming tech companies, often with their own research and development.

sentences.en: And beyond this, major CEOs still have to do all the day-to-day work they have always done.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，大公司CEO还必须完成他们历来承担的所有日常工作。

segments.text: And beyond this, major CEOs still have to do all the day-to-day work they have always done.

sentences.en: The common idea that high CEO pay is mainly about ripping people off doesn't explain history very well.
sentences.zh: 把CEO高薪主要解释成对他人的盘剥，这种常见观点并不能很好解释历史。

segments.text: The common idea that high CEO pay is mainly about ripping people off doesn't explain history very well.

sentences.en: By most measures, corporate governance has become a lot tighter and more rigorous since the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 按大多数衡量标准，自20世纪70年代以来，公司治理已经变得更加严密和严格。

segments.text: By most measures, corporate governance has become a lot tighter and more rigorous since the 1970s.

sentences.en: Yet it is principally during this period of stronger governance that CEO pay has been high and rising.
sentences.zh: 然而，恰恰主要是在治理不断加强的这一时期，CEO薪酬一直居高不下并持续上涨。

segments.text: Yet it is principally during this period of stronger governance that CEO pay has been high and rising.

sentences.en: That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs.
sentences.zh: 这说明，为越来越艰难的职位招募顶尖人才，符合公司的整体利益。

segments.text: That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs.

sentences.en: Furthermore, the highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates, not to the cozy insider picks, another sign that high CEO pay is not some kind of depredation at the expense of the rest of the company.
sentences.zh: 此外，最高的CEO薪酬往往付给外部候选人，而不是关系亲密的内部人选；这再次表明，高额CEO薪酬并不是以公司其他成员为代价的某种掠夺。

segments.text: Furthermore, the highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates, not to the cozy insider picks, another sign that high CEO pay is not some kind of depredation at the expense of the rest of the company.

sentences.en: And the stock market reacts positively when companies tie CEO pay to, say, stock prices, a sign that those practices build up corporate value not just for the CEO.
sentences.zh: 而当公司把CEO薪酬与股价等指标挂钩时，股票市场会作出积极反应，这说明此类做法提升的是公司价值，而不只是CEO个人的利益。

segments.text: And the stock market reacts positively when companies tie CEO pay to, say, stock prices, a sign that those practices build up corporate value not just for the CEO.
